segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yeah, so Dan, thanks for making time. I had you at 42 seats today, and the team asked about moving to 55 before the October 1 renewal. Is that still the right count?

segments.speaker: Dan
segments.text: That's right. Forty-two active now, plus 13 for the new claims group. We don't need them turned on until September 16, but we want the contract clean for October.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Got it. The order form I sent has 55 seats, annual term October 1, 2026 through September 30, 2027, at $96 per user per month. With the volume tier applied, total is $63,360 for the year.

segments.speaker: Dan
segments.text: Okay. Finance asked if you can invoice quarterly instead of annual upfront. Same total, just four invoices.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yes, quarterly billing is on there: $15,840 due October 1, January 1, April 1, and July 1, net 30. If you need a PO number printed on the invoices, send it over and we’ll include it.

segments.speaker: Dan
segments.text: Perfect. One more thing, our legal team wants the auto-renewal removed. We renew by written order only.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yep, that redline is already reflected. No auto-renewal, and renewal requires a signed order form. The rest of the terms stay as in the current agreement.

segments.speaker: Dan
segments.text: Good. On rollout, can your team do two admin trainings? We have one group in Ohio and one in Arizona, so time zones are a little messy.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: We can do Wednesday, September 17 at 11 a.m. Eastern and Thursday, September 18 at 2 p.m. Eastern. Those are included, no extra services charge.

segments.speaker: Dan
segments.text: That works. Send the final PDF to me and procurement, and I’ll route it today. If we sign by Friday, are we still okay for the September 16 seat activation?

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by August 9, activation on September 16 is covered, and the customer team will send the kickoff invite for the week of September 9.
